muyesser-irab:44-44.t:
﴿تحيتهم يوم يلقونه سلام﴾: a resumptive statement set out to explain what has been prepared for them in the Hereafter. (تحيتهم): mubtadaʾ (subject), and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), being the annexation of the maṣdar (verbal noun) to its object; (يوم): an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from (تحيتهم); the clause ﴿يلقونه﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; (سلام): khabar (predicate) of (تحيتهم); and the clause ﴿تحيتهم يوم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وأعد لهم أجرا كريما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (أعد): past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring to Allah; (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعد﴾; (أجرًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (كريما): an adjective.

muyesser-irab:45-45.t: ﴿يا أيها النبي إنا أرسلناك شاهدًا ومبشرًا ونذيرًا﴾: (يا): vocative particle; (أيها): (أي) is the one addressed, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) is for drawing attention; (النبي) is an adjective of ﴿أي﴾. (إنّا): (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters) and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; (أرسلناك): past verb, agent and object; the clause ﴿أرسلناك﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (شاهدًا): ḥāl (circumstantial) from the kāf of address in ﴿أرسلناك﴾, and it is an anticipated ḥāl (ḥāl muqaddara), i.e. "We sent you destined to be a witness over the messengers and the nations." (مبشرًا): conjoined to (شاهدًا), and (نذيرًا): also conjoined to (شاهدًا).

muyesser-irab:46-46.t: ﴿وداعيًا إلى الله بإذنه وسراجًا منيرًا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (داعيًا): conjoined to (شاهدًا); (إلى الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (داعيًا); (بإذنه): a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "accompanied by His facilitation." (سراجًا): also conjoined, and (منيرًا): an adjective.

muyesser-irab:47-47.t: ﴿وبشر المؤمنين بأن لهم من الله فضلًا كبيرًا﴾: conjoined to what preceded. (بشر): imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (المؤمنين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the bāʾ is a preposition; (أن): an abrogating, maṣdar-forming particle; (لهم): the fronted khabar (predicate) of (أن); (من الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿فضلا﴾; (فضلا): the postponed noun of (أن); (كبيرًا): an adjective of (فضلا); and ﴿أنّ﴾ together with what falls within its scope is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the preposition ﴿الباء﴾, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to ﴿بشر﴾.

muyesser-irab:48-48.t:
﴿ولا تطع الكافرين والمنافقين ودع أذاهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لا): prohibitive; (تطع): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (الكافرين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (المنافقين): conjoined to (الكافرين); (دع): imperative verb with a latent agent; (أذاهم): mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), by way of the annexation of the maṣdar (verbal noun) to its agent or to its object, and the mīm is the sign of the plural.
﴿وتوكل على الله وكفى بالله وكيلًا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (توكل): imperative verb with a latent agent; (على الله): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (توكل); (كفى): past verb; the bāʾ is a connective (ṣila) particle, and the Name of Majesty is genitive in form but nominative in position because it is the fāʿil of (كفى); (وكيلا): tamyīz (specification) or ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:49-49.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا إذا نكحتم المؤمنات﴾: (يا): vocative particle; (أيها): (أي) is the one addressed, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) is for drawing attention; (الذين) is an adjective of ﴿أي﴾. (آمنوا): verb and agent, and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. (إذا): an adverb of future time containing the sense of a condition; (نكحتم المؤمنات): verb, agent and object, and the clause ﴿نكحتم المؤمنات﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it.
﴿ثم طلقتموهن من قبل أن تمسوهن﴾: (ثم): conjunction; (طلقتموهن): past verb; the tāʾ is the fāʿil (agent), the mīm is the sign of the masculine plural, the wāw is for lengthening the ḍamma, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the nūn is a sign of the feminine with no grammatical position; (من قبل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (طلقتموهن); (أن): maṣdar-forming; (تمسوهن): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw of the group is the fāʿil, the hāʾ is mafʿūl bihi, and the nūn is a sign of the feminine with no grammatical position; and ﴿أنْ﴾ together with the imperfect verb after it is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct) in the genitive.
﴿فما لكم عليهن من عدة تعتدونها﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis of (إذا); (ما): negating; (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (عليهن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿عدة﴾; (مِن): a connective (ṣila) preposition; (عدة): genitive in form, nominative in position because it is the postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the clause ﴿تعتدونها﴾ is an adjective of (عدة).
﴿فمتعوهن وسرحوهن سراحا جميلا﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ indicating an implied condition); (متعوهن): imperative verb, agent and direct object; (سرحوهن): conjoined to (متعوهن); (سراحًا): standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); (جميلا): an adjective.

muyesser-irab:50-50.t:
﴿يا أيها النبي إنا أحللنا لك أزواجك اللاتي آتيت أجورهن﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يا): vocative particle; (أيها): (أيُّ) is the one addressed, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) is for drawing attention; (النبي) is an adjective of ﴿أي﴾. (إنّا): (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters) and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; the clause ﴿أحللنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (لك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أحللنا); (أزواجك): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (اللاتي): an adjective; the clause ﴿آتيت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿اللاتي﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (أجورهن): mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وما ملكت يمينك مما أفاء الله عليك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما): conjoined to (أزواجك); the clause ﴿ملكت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (يمينك): fāʿil (agent) of (ملكت); (مما): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) clarifying ﴿ما ملكت﴾; (أفاء الله): verb and agent; (عليك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (أفاء).
﴿وبنات عمك وبنات عماتك وبنات خالك وبنات خالاتك اللاتي هاجرن معك﴾: conjoined to ﴿أزواجك﴾; (اللاتي): an adjective, and the clause ﴿هاجرن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿اللاتي﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (معك): an adverb attached to (mutaʿalliq) (هاجرن).
﴿وامرأة مؤمنة إن وهبت نفسها للنبي﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (امرأة): maʿṭūf (conjoined) to ﴿أزواجك﴾; (مؤمنة): an adjective; (إن): conditional; (وهبت): past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "she" (هي); (نفسها): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (للنبي): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (وهبت); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by what precedes it, its implied form being "We made her lawful" (أحللناها).
﴿إن أراد النبي أن يستنكحها خالصة لك من دون المؤمنين﴾: (إن): conditional, restricting the first one; (أراد): past verb in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (النبي): fāʿil (agent); (أن): maṣdar-forming; (يستنكحها): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو), and ﴿ها﴾ is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the maṣdar-forming ﴿أنْ﴾ together with the imperfect verb after it is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), the mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أراد﴾; and the second conditional clause is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial). (خالصة): ḥāl from the object of ﴿يستنكحها﴾, or from the agent of (وهبتْ), or from ﴿امرأة﴾ because it has been qualified and thereby specified; or it is a naʿt (adjective) of an implied maṣdar, i.e. "an exclusive gift" (هبةً خالصةً). (لك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خالصة); (من دون): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (خالصة) or to a ḥāl from the pronoun in ﴿خالصة﴾; (المؤمنين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿قد علمنا ما فرضنا عليهم في أزواجهم وما ملكت أيمانهم﴾: (قد): particle of verification; (علمنا): verb and agent; (ما): object of (علمنا), and the clause ﴿فرضنا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (عليهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿فرضنا﴾; (في أزواجهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿فرضنا﴾; (ما): conjoined to (أزواجهم), and the clause ﴿ملكت أيمانهم﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿قد علمنا...﴾ is parenthetical, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿لكيلا يكون عليك حرج﴾: the lām is for causation; (كي): maṣdar-forming and governing the accusative; (لا): negating. (يكون): an incomplete imperfect verb (one of kāna and its sisters), accusative (manṣūb) by ﴿كي﴾; ﴿كي﴾ together with what follows it is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by the lām of causation, and the lām of causation and its genitive are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿خالصة﴾. (عليك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of (يكون); (حرج): the postponed noun of (يكون).
﴿وكان الله غفورا رحيما﴾: (كان) is an incomplete past verb, and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (غفورا): khabar (predicate) of (كان), accusative (manṣūb); (رحيما): a second khabar of ﴿كان﴾.

muyesser-irab:51-51.t:
﴿ترجي من تشاء منهن وتؤوي إليك من تشاء﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (ترجي): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (مَن): object of (ترجي), and the clause ﴿تشاء﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position. (منهن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿مَن﴾ or from the implied resumptive pronoun, i.e. "whomever you wish to defer from among them." (تؤوي): conjoined to (ترجي); (إليك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تؤوي); (مَن): object of (تؤوي), and the clause ﴿تشاء﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ومن ابتغيت ممن عزلت فلا جناح عليك﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (مَن): conditional, in the position of the accusative as the fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿ابتغيت﴾, and ﴿ابتغيت﴾ is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ) in the position of the jussive, and the clause ﴿فلا جناح عليك﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); or ﴿مَن﴾ is a relative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿فلا جناح عليك﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, joined with the fāʾ because the relative is treated like a condition, and the clause ﴿ابتغيت﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun ﴿مَن﴾, a clause with no grammatical position, the resumptive pronoun being omitted. The fāʾ is linking; (لا): the lā of generic negation; (جناح): noun of (لا); (عليك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar of ﴿لا﴾; and the clause ﴿ومن ابتغيت...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿ذلك أدنى أن تقر أعينهن ولا يحزن ويرضين بما آتيتهن كلهن﴾: (ذلك): mubtadaʾ (subject); (أدنى): khabar (predicate); (أن): maṣdar-forming; (تقر): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن), and the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾ together with what falls within its scope is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun), accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "closer to [إلى] their eyes being comforted," the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أدنى﴾. (أعينهن): fāʿil (agent) of (تقرَّ); the wāw is a conjunction; (لا): negating; (يحزنَّ): verb and agent, and the clause ﴿لا يحزنَّ﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تقرَّ أعينهن﴾; (يرضين): conjoined to ﴿تقرَّ أعينهن﴾; (بما): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يرضين﴾. The clause ﴿آتيتهن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, a clause with no grammatical position. (كلهن): tawkīd (emphasis) of the nūn in (يرضين).
﴿والله يعلم ما في قلوبكم وكان الله عليما حليما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (الله): mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿يعلم﴾ is the khabar (predicate); (ما): object of (يعلم); (في قلوبكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, i.e. ﴿يعلم ما استقر في قلوبكم﴾ "He knows what is settled in your hearts," and the ṣila clause has no grammatical position. The clause ﴿والله يعلم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. (كان) is an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (عليما): khabar of (كان), accusative (manṣūb); (حليما): a second khabar of ﴿كان﴾.

muyesser-irab:52-52.t:
﴿لا يحل لك النساء من بعد ولا أن تبدل بهن من أزواج﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (لا): negating; (يحل): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ); (لك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يحل); (النساء): fāʿil (agent); (من بعد): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from (النساء); the adverb ﴿بعدُ﴾ is built (mabnī) on the ḍamma because it is cut off from annexation in wording but not in meaning. The wāw is a conjunction; (لا): negating; (أن): maṣdar-forming; (تبدل): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن), and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); the maṣdar-forming ﴿أن﴾ together with the imperfect verb after it is an interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) conjoined to (النساء). (بهن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تبدل); (مِن): a connective (ṣila) particle; (أزواج): genitive in form, accusative in position as mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿ولو أعجبك حسنهن﴾: the wāw is circumstantial; (لو): conditional; (أعجبك): past verb, and the kāf is the fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (حسنهن): the postponed fāʿil (agent); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is implied, indicated by what precedes it; and the conditional clause is a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of (تبدل).
﴿إلا ما ملكت يمينك﴾: (إلا): particle of exception; (ما): a relative noun in the position of the accusative, excepted from (النساء), or in the position of the nominative as a badal (substitute); and the clause ﴿ملكت يمينك﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وكان الله على كل شيء رقيبا﴾: (كان) is an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (على كل شيء): a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿رقيبًا﴾; (رقيبا): khabar (predicate) of (كان), accusative (manṣūb).

muyesser-irab:53-53.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تدخلوا بيوت النبي﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يا): vocative particle; (أيها): (أي) is the one addressed, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) is for drawing attention; (الذين) is an adjective of ﴿أي﴾. (آمنوا): verb and agent, and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, a clause with no grammatical position. (لا): prohibitive; (تدخلوا): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil (agent); (بيوت): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) by extension of usage (ʿalā al-saʿa); (النبي): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿إلا أن يؤذن لكم إلى طعام غير ناظرين إناه﴾: (إلا): particle of restriction; (أن): maṣdar-forming; (يؤذن): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن), passive; (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤذن); (إلى طعام): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (يؤذن), because it has the meaning "unless you are invited to a meal." ﴿أن يؤذن﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "except being given permission." (غير): ḥāl from the agent in (تدخلوا) or from the genitive pronoun in (لكم); (ناظرين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (إناه): mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of the active participle (ناظرين).
﴿ولكن إذا دعيتم فادخلوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (لكن): a particle of rectification (istidrāk), lightened and inoperative; (إذا): an adverb of future time containing the sense of a condition, and the clause ﴿دعيتم﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it. The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (ادخلوا): imperative verb and agent.
﴿فإذا طعمتم فانتشروا ولا مستأنسين لحديث﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (إذا): an adverb of future time containing the sense of a condition, and the clause ﴿طعمتم﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it. The fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (انتشروا): imperative verb, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil (agent); the wāw is a conjunction; (لا): connective (ṣila), to emphasise the negation; (مستأنسين): conjoined to ﴿غير ناظرين﴾ or to an implied ḥāl (circumstantial), i.e. "do not enter them barging in, nor lingering," so it is a conjoined accusative; and it has been said that it is genitive, conjoined to (ناظرين). (لحديث): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (مستأنسين).
﴿إن ذلكم كان يؤذي النبي فيستحيي منكم والله لا يستحيي من الحق﴾: the clause gives the reason for the prohibition. (إن): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); (ذلكم): noun of (إن); (كان): an incomplete verb, and the noun of (كان) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هو); the clause ﴿يؤذي النبي﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (كان), and the clause ﴿كان يؤذي النبي﴾ is the khabar of (إن). (فيستحيي): conjoined to (يؤذي); (منكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يستحيي﴾; the wāw is circumstantial or resumptive; (الله): mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause ﴿لا يستحيي من الحق﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿والله لا يستحي من الحق﴾ is in the position of the accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial), or it is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿وإذا سألتموهن متاعا فاسألوهن من وراء حجاب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (إذا): an adverb for future time containing the sense of a condition, and the clause ﴿سألتموهن﴾ is in the position of the genitive by the annexation of the adverb to it; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (اسألوهن): imperative verb, agent and first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (متاعًا): second mafʿūl bihi; (من وراء): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (اسألوهن); (حجاب): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿ذلكم أطهر لقلوبكم وقلوبهن﴾: (ذلكم): mubtadaʾ (subject); (أطهر): khabar (predicate); (لقلوبكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أطهر); (قلوبهن): conjoined to (قلوبكم).
﴿وما كان لكم أن تؤذوا رسول الله ولا أن تنكحوا أزواجه من بعده أبدا﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (ما): negating; (كان): an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters); (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of (كان); (أن): maṣdar-forming; (تؤذوا): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by (أن), the sign of its accusative being the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) formed from the maṣdar-forming ﴿أنْ﴾ and the imperfect verb is the postponed noun of (كان). (رسول الله): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿وما كان لكم...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. (ولا): the wāw is a conjunction and (لا) is for emphasising the negation; ﴿أن تنكحوا﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أن تؤذوا﴾; (أزواجه): mafʿūl bihi, and the hāʾ is muḍāf ilayhi; (من بعده): a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); (أبدًا): an adverb, accusative (manṣūb).
﴿إن ذلكم كان عند الله عظيما﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle, and (ذلكم) is its noun; (كان): an incomplete past verb, and the noun of (كان) is latent (mustatir); (عند الله): ḥāl (circumstantial) from the noun of (كان), and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); (عظيمًا): khabar (predicate) of (كان); and the clause ﴿كان عند الله عظيما﴾ is the khabar of (إن).

muyesser-irab:54-54.t: ﴿إن تبدوا شيئا أو تخفوه فإن الله كان بكل شيء عليما﴾: (إن): conditional; (تبدوا): the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil (agent); (شيئًا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (أو): conjunction; (تخفوه): verb, agent and direct object, and the clause ﴿تخفوه﴾ is conjoined to ﴿تبدوا شيئا﴾; the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (كان): an incomplete verb, and the noun of (كان) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); (بكل شيء): a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عليمًا﴾; (عليمًا): khabar (predicate) of (كان); and the clause ﴿كان بكل شيء عليما﴾ is the khabar of (إن).

muyesser-irab:55-55.t:
﴿لا جناح عليهن في آبائهن﴾: (لا): the lā of generic negation; (جناح): noun of (لا); (عليهن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of (لا); (في آبائهن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the notion of "being established" (al-istiqrār) to which the khabar is attached.
﴿ولا أبنائهن ولا إخوانهن ولا أبناء إخوانهن ولا أبناء أخواتهن ولا نسائهن ولا ما ملكت أيمانهن﴾: conjoined to what preceded, and the clause ﴿ملكت أيمانهن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿واتقين الله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (اتقين): imperative verb, conjoined to something omitted, i.e. "comply with what you have been commanded and fear Allah," by way of iltifāt (a shift) from the third person to direct address; the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil (agent), and the Name of Majesty is the object of (اتَّقِين).
﴿إن الله كان على كل شيء شهيدا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (كان): an incomplete verb, and the noun of (كان) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); (على كل شيء): a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) (شهيدا); (شهيدا): khabar (predicate) of (كان); and the clause ﴿كان على كل شيء شهيدا﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar of (إن).

muyesser-irab:56-56.t:
﴿إن الله وملائكته يصلون على النبي﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (ملائكته): conjoined to the Name of Majesty; the clause ﴿يصلون على النبي﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (على النبي): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يصلون).
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا صلوا عليه وسلموا تسليما﴾: (يا): vocative particle; (أيها): (أي) is the one addressed, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) is for drawing attention; (الذين) is an adjective of ﴿أي﴾. (آمنوا): verb and agent, and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, a clause with no grammatical position. (صلوا): imperative verb, and the wāw of the group is the fāʿil (agent); (عليه): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (صلوا); (سلموا): conjoined to (صلوا); (تسليمًا): an emphasising mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:57-57.t:
﴿إن الذين يؤذون الله ورسوله لعنهم الله في الدنيا والآخرة﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and (الذين) is its noun; (يؤذون الله): verb, agent and object; (رسوله): conjoined to the Name of Majesty; the clause ﴿يؤذون الله ورسوله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿لعنهم الله﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (في الدنيا): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (لعنهم); (الآخرة): conjoined to (الدنيا).
﴿وأعد لهم عذابا مهينا﴾: conjoined to the clause ﴿لعنهم الله﴾. (أعد): past verb, and its agent is latent (mustatir); (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعد); (عذابًا): object of (أعد); (مهينا): an adjective.

muyesser-irab:58-58.t:
﴿والذين يؤذون المؤمنين والمؤمنات بغير ما اكتسبوا﴾: (الذين): mubtadaʾ (subject); (يؤذون): verb and agent; (المؤمنين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (المؤمنات): conjoined to (المؤمنين); the clause ﴿يؤذون المؤمنين والمؤمنات﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position. (بغير): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يؤذون); (ما): a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); and the clause ﴿اكتسبوا﴾ is the ṣila of the relative, a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فقد احتملوا بهتانا وإثما مبينا﴾: the fāʾ is linking; (قد): particle of verification; (احتملوا): verb and agent; (بهتانًا): object of (احتملوا); (إثمًا): conjoined to (بهتانًا); (مبينًا): an adjective; and the clause ﴿فقد احتملوا ...﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (الذين).

muyesser-irab:59-59.t:
﴿يا أيها النبي قل لأزواجك وبناتك ونساء المؤمنين﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يا): vocative particle; (أيها): (أي) is the one addressed, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) is for drawing attention; (النبي) is an adjective of ﴿أي﴾. (قل): imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (لأزواجك): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قل﴾; (بناتك): conjoined to ﴿أزواجك﴾; (نساء المؤمنين): also conjoined to ﴿أزواجك﴾, and (المؤمنين): muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿يدنين عليهن من جلابيبهن﴾: the clause ﴿يدنين﴾ is the object of the saying (maqūl al-qawl); (عليهن): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يدنين); (من جلابيبهن): a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of the accusative as the object of (يدنين), and ﴿مِن﴾ here is partitive.
﴿ذلك أدنى أن يعرفن فلا يؤذين﴾: (ذلك): mubtadaʾ (subject); (أدنى): khabar (predicate); (أن): maṣdar-forming; (يعرفن): an imperfect, an imperfect verb [Translator's note: the word "imperfect" is repeated in the source], indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and it is passive; the nūn of the feminine plural is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يعرفن﴾ is accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "closer to [إلى] their being recognised." The fāʾ is a conjunction; (لا): negating; (يؤذين): imperfect verb, indeclinable on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and it is passive; the nūn of the feminine plural is the nāʾib fāʿil; and the clause ﴿يؤذين﴾ is conjoined to ﴿يعرفن﴾.
﴿وكان الله غفورا رحيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (كان) is an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (غفورا): khabar of (كان), accusative (manṣūb); (رحيما): a second khabar of ﴿كان﴾; and the clause ﴿وكان الله...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:60-60.t:
﴿لئن لم ينته المنافقون والذين في قلوبهم مرض والمرجفون في المدينة لنغرينك بهم﴾: the lām paves the way for an oath (al-lām al-muwaṭṭiʾa li-l-qasam); (إن): conditional; (لم): a particle of negation, inversion [of tense] and the jussive; (ينته): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by (لم), and it serves as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); (المنافقون): fāʿil (agent); (الذين): conjoined to (المنافقون); (في قلوبهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); (مرض): postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); and the nominal clause ﴿في قلوبهم مرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, a clause with no grammatical position. (المرجفون) is also conjoined to (المنافقون); (في المدينة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (المرجفون). The lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; (نغرينك): imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa because it is attached to the heavy nūn of emphasis, and the fāʿil is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "We" (نحن), and the kāf is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (بهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (نغرينك); and the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the response to the oath.
﴿ثم لا يجاورونك فيها إلا قليلا﴾: conjoined to the response to the oath. (ثم): conjunction; (لا): negating; (يجاورونك): imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), the sign of its nominative being the retention of the nūn; the wāw is its fāʿil (agent) and the kāf its object; (فيها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of (يجاورونك); (إلا): particle of restriction; (قليلا): a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "except a little neighbouring" (إلا جوارا قليلا), or a naʿt of an omitted adverb attached to (يجاورونك), its implied form being "except a short time" (إلا زمنا قليلا); or ﴿قليلا﴾ is a ḥāl from the agent of (يجاورونك), i.e. "except in a state of being few and abased."

muyesser-irab:61-61.t: ﴿ملعونين أينما ثقفوا أخذوا وقتلوا تقتيلا﴾: (ملعونين): ḥāl (circumstantial) from the agent of (يجاورونك), or accusative by way of censure (al-dhamm); (أينما): a conditional noun governing the jussive, in the position of the accusative as an adverb of place, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخذوا﴾; (ثقفوا): passive past verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and the wāw of the group is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (أخذوا): the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), a past verb, also passive, indeclinable on the ḍamma, in the position of the jussive, and the wāw of the group is the nāʾib fāʿil; (قتلوا): passive past verb; (تقتيلا): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); and the clause ﴿قتلوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿أخذوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:62-62.t: ﴿سنة الله في الذين خلوا من قبل ولن تجد لسنة الله تبديلا﴾: (سنة): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) by an implied verb from its own root, i.e. "Allah has established that as a practice" (سنَّ الله ذلك سنة). The Name of Majesty: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (في الذين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from (سنة); the clause ﴿خلوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, a clause with no grammatical position. (من قبل): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خلوا﴾; the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial; (لن): a particle of negation, the accusative and the future; (تجد): imperfect verb, accusative by (لن); (لسنة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (تبديلا), and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; (تبديلا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:63-63.t:
﴿يسألك الناس عن الساعة﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (يسألك): imperfect verb, and the kāf is the fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الناس): fāʿil (agent); (عن الساعة): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (يسألك).
﴿قل إنما علمها عند الله﴾: (قل): imperative verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "you" (أنت); (إنما): the restraining (kāffa) and the restrained (makfūfa); (علمها): mubtadaʾ (subject); (عند): an adverb of place attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وما يدريك لعل الساعة تكون قريبا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (ما): an interrogative noun in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يدريك): imperfect verb, latent agent and first object, and the clause ﴿يدريك﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ; (لعل): an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters); (الساعة): noun of (لعل); (تكون): an incomplete verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the noun of (تكون) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "it" (هي); (قريبًا): khabar of (تكون), on the view that the qualified noun is omitted, i.e. "something near" (شيئا قريبا), or it is an adverb in the position of the khabar; the clause ﴿تكون قريبا﴾ is the khabar of (لعل); and the clause ﴿لعل الساعة ...﴾ is in the position of the accusative, standing in place of the second and third objects of the verb ﴿يدريك﴾.

muyesser-irab:64-64.t: ﴿إن الله لعن الكافرين وأعد لهم سعيرا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (لعن): past verb, and its fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); (الكافرين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿لعن الكافرين﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (أعد): conjoined to (لعن); (لهم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أعد); (سعيرًا): mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:65-65.t: ﴿خالدين فيها أبدا لا يجدون وليا ولا نصيرا﴾: (خالدين): ḥāl (circumstantial) from (الكافرين); (فيها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (خالدين); (أبدًا): an adverb of time, also attached to (خالدين); the clause ﴿لا يجدون﴾ is a second ḥāl; (وليًّا): object of (يجدون); (ولا نصيرًا): conjoined to (وليًّا).

muyesser-irab:66-66.t: ﴿يوم تقلب وجوههم في النار يقولون يا ليتنا أطعنا الله وأطعنا الرسولا﴾: (يوم): an adverb of time attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يقولون﴾, or to ﴿لا يجدون﴾ in the previous ayah, or a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being "remember the day when [their faces] are turned" (اذكر يومَ تُقلَّب). (تقلب): passive imperfect verb; (وجوههم): nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); (في النار): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تقلب﴾; and the clause ﴿تقلب﴾ is in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is either resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position, or circumstantial, in the position of the accusative. (يا): a particle for drawing attention, or a vocative particle with the one addressed omitted. (ليتنا): (ليت) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters) expressing a wish, and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; (أطعنا): verb and agent, and the Name of Majesty is the object of (أطعنا); the clause ﴿أطعنا الله﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (ليت); (أطعنا الرسولا): conjoined to ﴿أطعنا الله﴾; (الرسولا): object of (أطعنا), and the alif is for prolongation (al-iṭlāq).

muyesser-irab:67-67.t: ﴿وقالوا ربنا إنا أطعنا سادتنا وكبراءنا فأضلونا السبيلا﴾: the wāw is resumptive or conjoins to the clause ﴿يقولون﴾; (ربنا): the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) because it is annexed to the pronoun ﴿نا﴾; (إنّا): (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; (أطعنا): verb and agent; (سادتنا): object of (أطعنا); (كبراءنا): conjoined to (سادتنا); and the clause ﴿أطعنا سادتنا وكبراءنا﴾ is in the position of the nominative as the khabar (predicate) of (إن). (فأضلونا): conjoined to (أطعنا); (أضلونا): past verb, agent and mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (السبيلا): second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿أضلونا﴾, or accusative by removal of the preposition, i.e. "they led us astray from the way" (أضلونا عن السبيل), and the alif is for prolongation (al-iṭlāq); and the clause ﴿وقالوا ربنا...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:68-68.t: ﴿ربنا آتهم ضعفين من العذاب والعنهم لعنا كبيرا﴾: (ربنا): the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) because it is annexed to the pronoun ﴿نا﴾; (آتهم): a verb of supplication, a latent (mustatir) agent and a first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (ضعفين): second mafʿūl bihi; (من العذاب): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of (ضعفين); (العنهم): a verb of supplication, a latent agent and a mafʿūl bihi; (لعنًا): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); (كبيرًا): naʿt (adjective) of ﴿لعنًا﴾.

muyesser-irab:69-69.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا لا تكونوا كالذين آذوا موسى﴾: (يا): vocative particle; (أيها): (أي) is the one addressed, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) is for drawing attention; (الذين): an adjective of ﴿أي﴾. (آمنوا): verb and agent, and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, a clause with no grammatical position. (لا): prohibitive; (تكونوا): an incomplete imperfect verb (one of kāna and its sisters), jussive (majzūm) by (لا), and the wāw of the group is the noun of (تكون); in ﴿كالذين﴾ the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable on the fatḥa, in the position of the accusative as the khabar (predicate) of ﴿تكون﴾, and (الذين) is a relative noun in the position of the genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). (آذوا): verb and agent; (موسى): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and the clause ﴿آذوا موسى﴾ is the ṣila of (الذين), a clause with no grammatical position.
﴿فبرأه الله مما قالوا وكان عند الله وجيها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (برأه الله): verb, fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object) and postponed fāʿil (agent); (مما): ﴿من﴾ is a preposition and ﴿ما﴾ is maṣdar-forming, interpreted together with what follows it as a maṣdar (verbal noun) in the genitive by ﴿من﴾, i.e. "from their saying," the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿برأه﴾; or ﴿ما﴾ is relative, i.e. "from that which they said." The wāw is a conjunction; (كان): an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the noun of (كان) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being ﴿هو﴾ "he", referring to Moses; (عند الله): the adverb is attached to ﴿وجيهًا﴾, and the Name of Majesty is muḍāf ilayhi; (وجيهًا): khabar of (كان).

muyesser-irab:70-70.t: ﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا اتقوا الله وقولوا قولا سديدا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. (يا): vocative particle; (أيها): (أي) is the one addressed, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of the accusative, and (ها) is for drawing attention; (الذين): an adjective of ﴿أي﴾; (آمنوا): verb and agent, and the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative, a clause with no grammatical position. (اتقوا): imperative verb and agent, and the Name of Majesty is the object of (اتقوا); (قولوا): imperative verb and agent; (قولا): mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb) with the fatḥa. (سديدًا): naʿt (adjective) of ﴿قولا﴾; and the clause ﴿قولوا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿اتقوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:71-71.t:
﴿يصلح لكم أعمالكم ويغفر لكم ذنوبكم﴾: (يصلح): imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) in response to the request (jawāb al-ṭalab), and the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "He" (هو); (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يصلح﴾; (أعمالكم): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (يغفر): conjoined to (يصلح); (لكم): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغفر﴾; (ذنوبكم): object of (يغفر).
﴿ومن يطع الله ورسوله فقد فاز فوزا عظيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (من): a conditional noun governing the jussive, in the position of the nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); (يطع): the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive; the Name of Majesty is the object of (يطع); (رسوله): conjoined to the Name of Majesty. (فقد): the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) because it is joined with (قد); (فاز): past verb, and its agent is latent, its implied form being ﴿هو﴾ "he"; (فوزًا): mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); (عظيمًا): naʿt (adjective); the clause ﴿فقد فاز ...﴾ is in the position of the jussive as the apodosis; and the clause ﴿ومن يطع الله...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:72-72.t:
﴿إنا عرضنا الأمانة على السماوات والأرض والجبال﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. (إن) is an abrogating particle (one of inna and its sisters), and ﴿نا﴾ is its noun; (عرضنا): verb and agent; (الأمانة): object of (عرضنا); the clause ﴿عرضنا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of (إن); (على السماوات): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (عرضنا); (الأرض): conjoined to (السماوات); (الجبال): also conjoined to (السماوات).
﴿فأبين أن يحملنها وأشفقن منها﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; (أبين): past verb, and the nūn is the fāʿil (agent); (أن): maṣdar-forming; (يحملنها): imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, and the nūn is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from ﴿أن يحملنها﴾ is the object of ﴿أبين﴾. (أشفقن): conjoined to (أبين); (منها): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) (أشفقن).
﴿وحملها الإنسان﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (حملها): past verb and fronted mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (الإنسان): postponed fāʿil (agent); and the clause ﴿وحملها﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿أبين﴾.
﴿إنه كان ظلوما جهولا﴾: (إن) is an abrogating particle, and the hāʾ is its noun; (كان): an incomplete verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the noun of (كان) is latent (mustatir), its implied form being "he" (هو); (ظلومًا): the first khabar (predicate) of (كان); (جهولا): the second khabar of (كان); and the clause ﴿كان ظلوما جهولا﴾ is the khabar of (إن).

muyesser-irab:73-73.t:
﴿ليعذب الله المنافقين والمنافقات والمشركين والمشركات﴾: the lām is for causation or for outcome and consequence (al-ṣayrūra wa-l-ʿāqiba); (يعذب): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) (أن) after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar (verbal noun) from the implied ﴿أن﴾ and the verb is genitive by the lām, and the lām and its genitive are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿حملها﴾ or to ﴿عرضنا﴾; the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); (المنافقين): mafʿūl bihi (direct object); (المنافقات والمشركين والمشركات): conjoined to (المنافقين).
﴿ويتوب الله على المؤمنين والمؤمنات﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; (يتوب): imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by conjunction with (يعذب); the Name of Majesty is the fāʿil (agent); (على المؤمنين): a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتوب﴾; (المؤمنات): conjoined to (المؤمنين); and the clause ﴿يتوب الله﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿يعذب الله﴾.
﴿وكان الله غفورا رحيما﴾: the wāw is resumptive; (كان) is an incomplete past verb (one of kāna and its sisters), and the Name of Majesty is its noun; (غفورا): khabar (predicate) of (كان), accusative; (رحيما): a second khabar of ﴿كان﴾; and the clause ﴿وكان الله...﴾ is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يا أيها النبي اتق الله ولا تطع الكافرين والمنافقين﴾: يا: a vocative particle; أي: the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative; ها: for drawing attention (tanbīh); النبي: an adjective of ﴿أي﴾; اتق: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; the word of majesty (Allah) is the object of ﴿اتَّقِ﴾; the wāw is a conjunction; لا: prohibitive; تطع: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لا, its fāʿil a latent pronoun, implied as "you"; الكافرين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); المنافقين: conjoined to الكافرين.
﴿إن الله كان عليما حكيما﴾: إنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty being its noun; كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) verb, the noun of كان being latent, implied as "he"; عليمًا: the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative (manṣūb); حكيمًا: a second khabar of ﴿كان﴾; the clause ﴿كان عليما حكيما﴾ is the khabar of إنّ, and the clause ﴿إن الله ...إلخ﴾ gives the reason for the command and the prohibition, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿واتبع ما يوحى إليك من ربك﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اتبع: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; ما: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); يوحى: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent, implied as "it"; the clause ﴿يوحى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. إليك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يوحى; من ربك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the latent nāʾib fāʿil.
﴿إن الله كان بما تعملون خبيرا﴾: إنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) verb, the noun of كان being latent, implied as "he"; بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خبيرا﴾; the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. خبيرا: the khabar (predicate) of كان, accusative (manṣūb); the clause ﴿كان بما تعملون خبيرا﴾ is the khabar of إنّ.

muyesser-irab:3-3.t: ﴿وتوكل على الله وكفى بالله وكيلا﴾: conjoined to what preceded; على الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) توكل; كفى: a past verb; the bāʾ is a ṣila (i.e. redundant) particle; الله: the fāʿil (agent) of كفى in position; وكيلا: tamyīz (specification), or ḥāl (circumstantial).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿ما جعل الله لرجل من قلبين في جوفه﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ما: negative; جعل الله: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); لرجل: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted second object of جعل, or attached to ﴿جعل﴾; قلبين: the object of جعل in position, genitive in form by ﴿مِن﴾, the ṣila (redundant) particle; في جوفه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of قلبين.
﴿وما جعل أزواجكم اللائي تظاهرون منهن أمهاتكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما: negative; جعل: a past verb, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), referring to Allah, glorified is He; أزواجكم: the first object of جعل; اللائي: a relative noun, an adjective; the clause ﴿تظاهرون﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. منهن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تظاهرون; ﴿تظاهرون﴾ is made transitive with ﴿مِن﴾ only because it has been made to include the sense of distancing, as though it were said: "they distance themselves from their wives because of ẓihār." أمهاتكم: the second object of جعل.
﴿وما جعل أدعياءكم أبناءكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما: negative; جعل: a past verb, its fāʿil latent, referring to Allah, glorified is He; أدعياءكم: the first object of جعل; أبناءكم: the second object of جعل.
﴿ذلكم قولكم بأفواهكم﴾: ذلكم: mubtadaʾ (subject); قولكم: khabar (predicate); بأفواهكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿قولكم﴾, i.e. "being only in your mouths, without any reality to it" (كائنًا بأفواهكم فقط من غير أن تكون له حقيقة).
﴿والله يقول الحق وهو يهدي السبيل﴾: the wāw is for circumstance (ḥāl) or for resumption; الله: mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿يقول﴾: khabar; الحق: an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "He says the true saying" (يقول القول الحق), or ﴿الحق﴾ is the object of ﴿يقول﴾. The clause ﴿والله يقول الحق﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, or resumptive, with no grammatical position. هو: mubtadaʾ; يهدي: an imperfect verb, its fāʿil latent, implied as "he"; السبيل: accusative by removal of the preposition, or a second object of يهدي; the clause ﴿يهدي السبيل﴾ is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿هو﴾.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿ادعوهم لآبائهم هو أقسط عند الله﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; ادعوهم: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); لآبائهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ادعوهم﴾; هو: mubtadaʾ (subject); أقسط: khabar (predicate); عند: an adverb (ẓarf), accusative (manṣūb), attached to ﴿أقسط﴾, and the word of majesty (Allah) is muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿فإن لم تعلموا آباءهم فإخوانكم في الدين ومواليكم﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إن: conditional; لم: a particle of negation, inversion (of tense) and jussive; تعلموا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by لم, the wāw of the plural being its fāʿil; آباءهم: the object of تعلموا. فإخوانكم: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إخوانكم: the khabar of an omitted mubtadaʾ, i.e. "then they are your brothers" (فهم إخوانكم). في الدين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to إخوانكم; مواليكم: conjoined to إخوانكم; the clause ﴿فإخوانكم﴾ is the apodosis, in the position of jussive.
﴿وليس عليكم جناح فيما أخطأتم به﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ليس: a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb; عليكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted fronted khabar of ليس; جناح: the postponed noun of ليس; فيما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of جناح; the clause ﴿أخطأتم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. به: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخطأتم.
﴿ولكن ما تعمدت قلوبكم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لكنْ: a particle of rectification (istidrāk), inoperative (muhmal); ما: conjoined to ﴿ما﴾ in His words ﴿فيما أخطأتم﴾, so its position is genitive; the clause ﴿تعمدت قلوبكم﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. Or ﴿ما﴾ is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, i.e. "you are taken to account for it" (تؤاخذون به), or "the blame is on you for it" (عليكم الجناح فيه).
﴿وكان الله غفورا رحيما﴾: كان: a defective verb (kāna and its sisters), the word of majesty being the noun of كان; غفورا: the khabar of كان, accusative; رحيما: a second khabar of ﴿كان﴾; the clause ﴿كان الله ...﴾ is circumstantial (ḥāliyya), in the position of accusative, or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿النبي أولى بالمؤمنين من أنفسهم﴾: النبي: mubtadaʾ (subject); أولى: khabar (predicate); بالمؤمنين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) أولى; من أنفسهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to أولى.
﴿وأزواجه أمهاتهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أزواجه: mubtadaʾ; أمهاتهم: khabar.
﴿وأولو الأرحام بعضهم أولى ببعض في كتاب الله من المؤمنين والمهاجرين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أولو: mubtadaʾ; الأرحام: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); بعضهم: a second mubtadaʾ; أولى: the khabar of the second mubtadaʾ; the clause ﴿بعضهم أولى ببعض﴾ is the khabar of the first mubtadaʾ ﴿أولو﴾; ببعض: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أولى, and an omitted muḍāf must be supplied, i.e. "to the inheritance of others" (بإرث بعض). في كتاب الله: a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to أولى or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in أولى; من المؤمنين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أولى, so ﴿مِن﴾ is comparative (tafḍīliyya), i.e. "relatives, some of them are more entitled to inherit from others than that the unrelated believers and emigrants should inherit from them." Or the preposition and its genitive noun ﴿من المؤمنين﴾ are attached to an omitted ḥāl from ﴿أولو الأرحام﴾, on the view that ﴿مِن﴾ is explicative (bayāniyya), and ﴿من المؤمنين﴾ explains أولي الأرحام. المهاجرين: conjoined to المؤمنين.
﴿إلا أن تفعلوا إلى أوليائكم معروفا﴾: إلا: a particle of exception; أن: maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar); تفعلوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن تفعلوا﴾ is the excepted (mustathnā); إلى أوليائكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تفعلوا after it has been made to include the sense of "render" (تؤدوا) or "confer" (تُسْدوا); معروفًا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿كان ذلك في الكتاب مسطورا﴾: كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) verb (kāna and its sisters); ذلك: the noun of كان; مسطورًا: the khabar of كان; في الكتاب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to مسطورًا.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿وإذ أخذنا من النبيين ميثاقهم ومنك ومن نوح وإبراهيم وموسى وعيسى ابن مريم﴾: the wāw is resumptive; إذ: a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, the implied form being: "and remember the time of Our taking a covenant" (واذكر وقت أخذنا ميثاقا). أخذنا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿أخذنا﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation; ﴿من النبيين﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخذنا﴾; ميثاقهم: mafʿūl bihi; the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; what follows it is conjoined to ﴿من النبيين﴾; ابن: an adjective of عيسى; مريم: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct).
﴿وأخذنا منهم ميثاقا غليظا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أخذنا: conjoined to the preceding ﴿أخذنا﴾; منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أخذنا; ميثاقا: mafʿūl bihi; غليظا: an adjective.

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿ليسأل الصادقين عن صدقهم﴾: the lām is causal (lām al-taʿlīl); يسأل: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a concealed أن after the lām; the concealed أن and the imperfect verb form an interpreted maṣdar, genitive (majrūr) by the causal lām, and the causal lām with the interpreted maṣdar it governs are attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أخذنا﴾, by way of a shift (iltifāt) from the first person to the third; the fāʿil (agent) of ﴿يسأل﴾ is latent (mustatir), referring to Allah the Exalted; الصادقين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عن صدقهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسأل﴾.
﴿وأعد للكافرين عذابا أليما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أعد: a past verb, its fāʿil latent, referring to Allah the Exalted; للكافرين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أعد﴾; عذابًا: mafʿūl bihi; أليمًا: an adjective. His words ﴿وأعد﴾ are conjoined to ﴿أخذنا من النبيين ...﴾ in that the sending of the messengers and the taking of the covenant from them are for the rewarding of the believers; or they are conjoined to what ﴿ليسأل﴾ indicates, as though He said: "so He rewarded the believers and prepared for the disbelievers a punishment" (فأثاب المؤمنين وأعد للكافرين عذابا).

muyesser-irab:9-9.t:
﴿يا أيها الذين آمنوا اذكروا نعمة الله عليكم إذ جاءتكم جنود فأرسلنا عليهم ريحا وجنودا لم تروها﴾: يا: a vocative particle; أيها: أي is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative, and ﴿ها﴾ is for drawing attention (tanbīh); الذين: an adjective of ﴿أي﴾. آمنوا: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿آمنوا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. اذكروا: an imperative verb and its fāʿil; نعمة الله: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), the word of majesty (Allah) being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); عليكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "remember His bestowing upon you" (اذكروا إنعامه عليكم), or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿نعمة﴾ if it is taken as a noun, i.e. "remember His favour as being upon you" (اذكروا نعمته كائنةً عليكم). إذ: an adverb for ﴿نعمة الله﴾, attached to it on the assumption that ﴿نعمة﴾ is taken as a maṣdar, or a noun indeclinable on the sukūn in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from ﴿نعمة الله﴾; the clause ﴿جاءتكم جنود﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation. فأرسلنا: conjoined to جاءتكم; عليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرسلنا﴾; ريحًا: mafʿūl bihi; جنودًا: conjoined to ريحًا; the clause ﴿لم تروها﴾ is an adjective of ﴿جنودًا﴾.
﴿وكان الله بما تعملون بصيرا﴾: كان: a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), the word of majesty being its noun; بما: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿بصيرًا﴾; the clause ﴿تعملون﴾ is the ṣila, with no grammatical position. بصيرًا: the khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿إذ جاءوكم من فوقكم ومن أسفل منكم﴾: إذ: a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative as a badal (substitute) from ﴿إذ﴾ in His words ﴿إذ جاءتكم﴾; the clause ﴿جاءوكم﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation; من فوقكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿جاءوكم﴾. ومن أسفل منكم: conjoined to ﴿من فوقكم﴾; منكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أسفل﴾.
﴿وإذ زاغت الأبصار وبلغت القلوب الحناجر وتظنون بالله الظنونا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذ: conjoined to the previous إذ; زاغت الأبصار: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); the clause ﴿زاغت الأبصار﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's annexation to it; the wāw is a conjunction; بلغت: a past verb; القلوب: fāʿil; الحناجر: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause is conjoined to the one before it, and likewise the clause ﴿تظنون بالله الظنونا﴾; تظنون: a verb and its fāʿil; بالله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تظنون﴾; الظنونا: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb), and the alif is for prolongation (al-iṭlāq).

muyesser-irab:11-11.t: ﴿هنالك ابتلي المؤمنون وزلزلوا زلزالا شديدا﴾: هنالك: ﴿هنا﴾ is a demonstrative in the position of accusative as an adverb (ẓarf), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ابتلي﴾; the lām is for distance, and the kāf for address. ابتُلي: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); المؤمنون: nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the wāw is a conjunction; زلزلوا: a passive past verb, the wāw of the plural being the nāʾib fāʿil; the clause ﴿زلزلوا﴾ is conjoined to ابتلي; زلزالا: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative (manṣūb); شديدًا: an adjective.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t: ﴿وإذ يقول المنافقون والذين في قلوبهم مرض ما وعدنا الله ورسوله إلا غرورا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذ: a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative, conjoined to ﴿إذ﴾ in ﴿إذ زاغت﴾; the clause ﴿يقول﴾ is in the position of genitive by annexation; المنافقون: fāʿil (agent); الذين: conjoined to ﴿المنافقون﴾; في قلوبهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); مرض: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿في قلوبهم مرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. ما: negative; وعدنا: a past verb, the pronoun being mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الله: fāʿil; رسوله: conjoined to it; إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); غرورًا: standing in for a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), i.e. "a promise of delusion" (وعْدَ الغرور), and the second object is omitted, i.e. "victory" (النصر). The clause ﴿ما وعدنا ...﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).

muyesser-irab:13-13.t:
﴿وإذ قالت طائفة منهم يا أهل يثرب لا مقام لكم فارجعوا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction joining to what preceded; ﴿إذ﴾: a noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn, in the position of accusative, conjoined to ﴿إذ يقول﴾; قالت طائفة: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of طائفة; يا: a vocative particle; أهل: the one addressed (munādā), annexed; يثرب: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), genitive (majrūr) with the fatḥa because it is a diptote; لا: the lā of generic negation; مقام: the noun of ﴿لا﴾, indeclinable on the fatḥa; لكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar (predicate) of ﴿لا﴾. فارجعوا: the fāʾ is a conjunction linking cause to effect; ارجعوا: an imperative verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil.
﴿ويستأذن فريق منهم النبي﴾: the wāw is resumptive, and the clause ﴿يستأذن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position. يستأذن: an imperfect verb. فريق: fāʿil. منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted adjective of فريق. النبي: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿يقولون إن بيوتنا عورة وما هي بعورة﴾: the clause ﴿يقولون﴾ is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl (circumstantial) from فريق, or a badal (substitute) from His words ﴿يستأذن﴾; and it has been said that it is resumptive, as an answer to an implied question about the manner of asking permission, so it has no grammatical position. إنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters). بيوتنا: the noun of إنّ, the pronoun being muḍāf ilayhi. عورة: the khabar of إنّ; the wāw is circumstantial; ما: the Ḥijāzī negative mā, which operates like ليس; ﴿هي﴾: the noun of ما; the bāʾ is a ṣila (i.e. redundant) preposition; عورة: the khabar of the Ḥijāzī ﴿ما﴾, accusative in position, genitive in form by the bāʾ.
﴿إن يريدون إلا فرارا﴾: إن: negative; يريدون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); فرارًا: mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:14-14.t:
﴿ولو دخلت عليهم من أقطارها ثم سئلوا الفتنة لآتوها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; دُخِلت: a past verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent (mustatir); عليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿دخلت﴾; من أقطارها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿دخلت﴾, the pronoun being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); ثم: a conjunction; سئلوا: a passive past verb, the wāw of the plural being the nāʾib fāʿil; الفتنة: the second mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of سئلوا; the lām occurs in the apodosis of لو; آتوها: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and a mafʿūl bihi, the second object being omitted, implied as "they would have given it to those asking" (لآتوها السائلين); the clause ﴿لآتوها﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
﴿وما تلبثوا بها إلا يسيرا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما: negative; تلبثوا: a past verb and its fāʿil; بها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تلبثوا; إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); يسيرًا: a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), the implied form being "except a little lingering" (إلا تلبثا يسيرا), or an adverb of time, the implied form being "except a little time" (إلا زمانا يسيرا).

muyesser-irab:15-15.t:
﴿ولقد كانوا عاهدوا الله من قبل لا يولون الأدبار﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; قد: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كانوا: a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw of the plural being its noun; the clause ﴿عاهدوا﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of كان, and the word of majesty (Allah) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); من قبل: ﴿مِن﴾ is a preposition, and ﴿قبلُ﴾ is an adverb indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma in the position of genitive, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عاهدوا﴾; the clause ﴿لا يولون الأدبار﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the response to the oath understood from ﴿عاهدوا﴾; الأدبار: the second mafʿūl bihi of يولون, the first object being omitted, i.e. "they would not turn their backs to the enemy" (لا يولون العدوَّ الأدبار).
﴿وكان عهد الله مسئولا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; كان: an abrogating verb; عهد: the noun of كان, the word of majesty being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); مسئولا: the khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:16-16.t:
﴿قل لن ينفعكم الفرار إن فررتم من الموت أو القتل﴾: قل: a verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); لن: a particle of negation, accusative and future; ينفعكم: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by لن, the kāf being mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الفرار: fāʿil; إن: a jussive conditional particle; فررتم: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) being omitted, indicated by what precedes it; من الموت: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) فررتم; أو: a conjunction; القتل: conjoined to الموت; the clause ﴿لن ينفعكم﴾ is the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وإذا لا تمتعون إلا قليلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إذًا: a particle of response and requital, inoperative (muhmal) because it comes after a conjunction; لا: negative; تمتعون: an imperfect verb, passive, the wāw of the plural being the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); قليلا: a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "except a little enjoyment" (إلا تمتيعا قليلا), or an adjective of an omitted adverb of time, i.e. "except a little time" (إلا زمانا قليلا).

muyesser-irab:17-17.t:
﴿قل من ذا الذي يعصمكم من الله إن أراد بكم سوءا أو أراد بكم رحمة﴾: قل: a verb and a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent); مَن: an interrogative noun, mubtadaʾ (subject); ذا: a demonstrative in the position of nominative as khabar (predicate); الذي: a badal (substitute); the clause ﴿يعصمكم من الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. من الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) يعصمكم; إن: conditional; أراد: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) being omitted, indicated by what precedes it, its implied form being: "then who is it that can protect you?" (فمن ذا الذي يعصمكم). سوءًا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أو: a conjunction; the clause ﴿أراد بكم رحمة﴾ is conjoined to ﴿أراد بكم سوءا﴾; رحمة: mafʿūl bihi.
﴿ولا يجدون لهم من دون الله وليا ولا نصيرا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction or circumstantial; لا: negative; يجدون: a verb and its fāʿil; لهم: a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of accusative as the second object of يجدون; من دون الله: a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿وليًّا﴾; وليًّا: the first mafʿūl bihi. ولا نصيرًا: the wāw is a conjunction, لا is for emphasising the negation, and نصيرا is conjoined to وليًّا.

muyesser-irab:18-18.t:
﴿قد يعلم الله المعوقين منكم والقائلين لإخوانهم هلم إلينا﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; قد: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); يعلم الله: a verb and its fāʿil (agent); المعوقين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); منكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial); القائلين: conjoined to المعوقين; لإخوانهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to القائلين; هلم: a verbal noun of command (ism fiʿl amr) meaning "come" (تعالوا); إلينا: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿هلم﴾.
﴿ولا يأتون البأس إلا قليلا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial (ḥāliyya); لا: negative; يأتون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; البأس: mafʿūl bihi; إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); قليلا: an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "except a little coming" (إلا إتيانا قليلا), or an adjective of an omitted adverb of time, i.e. "except a little time" (إلا زمانا قليلا).

muyesser-irab:19-19.t:
﴿أشحة عليكم﴾: أشحة: a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of يأتون, or accusative (manṣūb) for blame by an omitted verb implied as "I blame" (أذم).
﴿فإذا جاء الخوف رأيتهم ينظرون إليك﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إذا: an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition; the clause ﴿جاء الخوف﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's annexation to it; the clause ﴿رأيتهم﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; the clause ﴿ينظرون إليك﴾ is a ḥāl from the object of رأيتهم, because the seeing here is visual; إليك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ينظرون.
﴿تدور أعينهم كالذي يغشى عليه من الموت﴾: تدور أعينهم: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿تدور أعينهم﴾ is a ḥāl from the fāʿil of ينظرون. كالذي: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "rolling with a rolling like the rolling of the eye of ﴿الذي...﴾ etc."; الذي: a relative noun in the position of genitive as muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); the clause ﴿يغشى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position. يغشى: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive); عليه: a preposition and its genitive noun in the position of nominative as nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); ﴿من الموت﴾: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يغشى﴾.
﴿فإذا ذهب الخوف سلقوكم بألسنة حداد﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; إذا: an adverb of future time containing the sense of condition; ذهب الخوف: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿ذهب الخوف﴾ is in the position of genitive by the adverb's annexation to it; the clause ﴿سلقوكم﴾ is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition, with no grammatical position; بألسنة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to سلقوكم; حداد: a naʿt (adjective) of ألسنة.
﴿أشحة على الخير﴾: أشحة: a ḥāl, or accusative for blame; على الخير: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أشحة.
﴿أولئك لم يؤمنوا فأحبط الله أعمالهم﴾: أولئك: mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿لم يؤمنوا﴾: khabar (predicate); فأحبط: conjoined to ﴿لم يؤمنوا﴾; الله: fāʿil; أعمالهم: mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
﴿وكان ذلك على الله يسيرا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or resumptive; كان: a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters); ذلك: its noun; على الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يسيرًا﴾; يسيرًا: the khabar of كان; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:20-20.t:
﴿يحسبون الأحزاب لم يذهبوا﴾: the speech is resumptive, with no grammatical position; يحسبون: an imperfect verb, nominative (marfūʿ), and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil (agent); الأحزاب: the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿لم يذهبوا﴾: the second mafʿūl bihi.
﴿وإن يأت الأحزاب يودوا لو أنهم بادون في الأعراب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن: conditional; يأت: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; الأحزاب: fāʿil; يودوا: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), jussive, the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the nūn. لو: maṣdariyya (forming a maṣdar); أنهم: أنّ is an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), and ﴿هم﴾ is its noun; بادون: the khabar (predicate) of أنّ; في الأعراب: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted second khabar of ﴿أنّ﴾, or attached to ﴿بادون﴾, or to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun in ﴿بادون﴾; ﴿أنّ﴾ and what lies in its scope form an interpreted maṣdar that is the fāʿil of an omitted verb, the implied form being: "they would wish that it were established that they were dwelling in the desert" (يودوا لو ثبت أنهم بادون). The maṣdariyya ﴿لو﴾ and what follows it form an interpreted maṣdar that is the object of ﴿يودوا﴾.
﴿يسألون عن أنبائكم ولو كانوا فيكم ما قاتلوا إلا قليلا﴾: يسألون: an imperfect verb, and the wāw of the plural is the fāʿil; the clause ﴿يسألون﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position, or circumstantial (ḥāliyya); عن أنبائكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يسألون; the wāw is circumstantial; لو: conditional; كانوا: كان, a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), the wāw of the plural being its noun; فيكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to the omitted khabar of كان; ما: negative; قاتلوا: a verb and its fāʿil; the clause ﴿ما قاتلوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); قليلا: a naʿt (adjective) of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "except a little fighting" (إلا قتالا قليلا), or a naʿt of an omitted adverb, i.e. "except a little while" (إلا وقتًا قليلا).

muyesser-irab:21-21.t:
﴿لقد كان لكم في رسول الله أسوة حسنة﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; the lām occurs in the response to an implied oath; قد: a particle of realisation (taḥqīq); كان: a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters); لكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) the omitted fronted khabar (predicate) of كان; في رسول الله: a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿أسوة﴾; أسوة: the postponed noun of كان; حسنة: an adjective of أسوة.
﴿لمن كان يرجو الله واليوم الآخر وذكر الله كثيرا﴾: لمن: a preposition and its genitive noun, a badal (substitute) from ﴿لكم﴾; كان: an abrogating verb, the noun of كان being latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; the clause ﴿يرجو الله﴾ is the khabar of كان, and the clause ﴿كان يرجو الله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. اليوم الآخر: conjoined to the word of majesty (Allah); الآخر: a naʿt (adjective); ذكر: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent, implied as "he", the word of majesty being mafʿūl bihi (direct object); كثيرًا: an adjective of an omitted maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "much remembrance" (ذكرًا كثيرًا), or an adjective of an omitted adverb of time, i.e. "much time" (وقتًا كثيرًا).

muyesser-irab:22-22.t:
﴿ولما رأى المؤمنون الأحزاب قالوا هذا ما وعدنا الله ورسوله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; لما: an adverb meaning "when" (حين), attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قالوا﴾, containing the sense of condition; رأى: a past verb; المؤمنون: fāʿil (agent); الأحزاب: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿قالوا﴾ has no grammatical position, because it is the apodosis of a non-jussive condition; هذا: mubtadaʾ (subject); ما: khabar (predicate); وعدنا: a past verb, the pronoun being mafʿūl bihi; الله: fāʿil; رسوله: conjoined to the word of majesty; the clause ﴿وعدنا الله ورسوله﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿هذا ما وعدنا ...﴾ is in the position of accusative as the speech reported (maqūl al-qawl).
﴿وصدق الله ورسوله﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; صدق الله: a verb and its fāʿil; رسوله: conjoined to the word of majesty; the clause ﴿وصدق الله﴾ is conjoined to the speech reported, or is in the position of a ḥāl (circumstantial), with قد implied or without it.
﴿وما زادهم إلا إيمانا وتسليما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما: negative; إلا: a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); إيمانًا: the second mafʿūl bihi of زادهم; تسليمًا: conjoined to إيمانًا; the clause ﴿ما زادهم...﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿قالوا﴾.

muyesser-irab:23-23.t:
﴿من المؤمنين رجال صدقوا ما عاهدوا الله عليه﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; من المؤمنين: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted fronted khabar (predicate); رجال: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿صدقوا﴾ is an adjective of رجال; ما: a relative noun, mafʿūl bihi (direct object); عاهدوا الله: a verb, its fāʿil (agent) and object; عليه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to عاهدوا; the clause ﴿عاهدوا الله عليه﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿فمنهم من قضى نحبه ومنهم من ينتظر﴾: the fāʾ is for ramification (tafrīʿiyya); منهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; مَن: a postponed mubtadaʾ; قضى نحبه: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and an object; the clause ﴿قضى نحبه﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿مَن﴾, with no grammatical position. ومنهم من ينتظر: conjoined to what preceded it.
﴿وما بدلوا تبديلا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ما: negative; بدلوا: a verb and its fāʿil, the mafʿūl bihi being omitted; تبديلا: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object).

muyesser-irab:24-24.t:
﴿ليجزي الله الصادقين بصدقهم ويعذب المنافقين إن شاء أو يتوب عليهم﴾: the lām is the lām of cause (taʿlīl) or the lām of outcome (ṣayrūra); يجزي: an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a concealed أن after the lām; the concealed ﴿أن﴾ and the imperfect verb after it form an interpreted maṣdar, genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the lām with what it governs is attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ما بدَّلوا﴾, as though He said: "and they did not change at all, as the hypocrites changed"; or attached to something omitted, the implied form being: "all that happened happened so that Allah may reward the truthful ... etc." (وقع جميع ما وقع ليجزي الله الصادقين ...إلخ); and it has been said: attached to صدقوا. الله: fāʿil (agent); الصادقين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); بصدقهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يجزي; يعذب المنافقين: a verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿يعذب المنافقين﴾ is conjoined to ﴿ليجزي الله الصادقين﴾; إن: conditional; شاء: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm), and it is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is omitted, indicated by the context, as is the object of ﴿شاء﴾, the implied form being: "if He wills to punish them, He punishes them" (إن شاء تعذيبهم عذبهم). أو: a conjunction; يتوب: conjoined to ﴿يعذب﴾; عليهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يتوب﴾.
﴿إن الله كان غفورا رحيما﴾: إنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; كان: an abrogating verb, the noun of كان being a latent pronoun, implied as "he"; غفورًا: the first khabar (predicate) of كان; رحيمًا: the second khabar of كان; the clause ﴿كان غفورا رحيما﴾ is the khabar of إنّ, and the clause ﴿إن الله ...﴾ is causal (taʿlīliyya).

muyesser-irab:25-25.t:
﴿ورد الله الذين كفروا بغيظهم لم ينالوا خيرا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; رد: a past verb; الله: fāʿil (agent); الذين: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿كفروا﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. بغيظهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from ﴿الذين كفروا﴾, the pronoun being muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), i.e. "He turned them back enraged" (ردهم مَغيظين); لم: a particle of negation that makes the imperfect verb jussive; ينالوا: an imperfect verb, jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the nūn; خيرًا: the object of ينالوا; the clause ﴿لم ينالوا خيرًا﴾ is a second ḥāl.
﴿وكفى الله المؤمنين القتال﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; ﴿كفى الله المؤمنين﴾: a verb, its fāʿil and the first mafʿūl bihi; القتال: the second mafʿūl bihi, because ﴿كفى﴾ here means "protected" (وقى), and it is transitive to two objects.
﴿وكان الله قويا عزيزا﴾: كان: an abrogating verb (kāna and its sisters); الله: the noun of كان; قويًا: the first khabar (predicate) of كان; عزيزًا: the second khabar of كان.

muyesser-irab:26-26.t:
﴿وأنزل الذين ظاهروهم من أهل الكتاب من صياصيهم﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أنزل: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), referring to Allah; الذين: a relative noun in the position of accusative as mafʿūl bihi (direct object); ظاهروهم: a verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi; the clause ﴿ظاهروهم﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause), with no grammatical position. من أهل الكتاب: a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil of ظاهروهم; من صياصيهم: a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi, the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to أنزل.
﴿وقذف في قلوبهم الرعب﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قذف: conjoined to أنزل; في قلوبهم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to قذف; الرعب: the mafʿūl bihi of قذف.
﴿فريقا تقتلون وتأسرون فريقا﴾: فريقًا: a fronted object of تقتلون; the wāw is a conjunction; تأسرون فريقًا: a verb, its fāʿil and a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:27-27.t:
﴿وأورثكم أرضهم وديارهم وأموالهم وأرضا لم تطئوها﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أورثكم: a past verb, a latent (mustatir) fāʿil (agent) and the first mafʿūl bihi (direct object); أرضهم: the second mafʿūl bihi; ديارهم, أموالهم and أرضًا: conjoined to ﴿أرضهم﴾; the clause ﴿لم تطئوها﴾: an adjective of ﴿أرضًا﴾.
﴿وكان الله على كل شيء قديرا﴾: كان: a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; على كل شيء: a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قديرا﴾; قديرا: the khabar (predicate) of كان.

muyesser-irab:28-28.t:
