﴿يا أيها النبي قل لأزواجك إن كنتن تردن الحياة الدنيا وزينتها﴾: resumptive speech with no grammatical position; يا: a vocative particle; أيها: أي is the one addressed (munādā), indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of accusative, and ها is for drawing attention (tanbīh); النبي: an adjective of ﴿أي﴾. قل: an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) latent (mustatir), implied as "you"; لأزواجك: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) قل; إن: conditional; كنتن: a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters) in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ being its noun and the nūn the sign of the feminine plural; the clause ﴿تردن﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of kāna, the nūn being the fāʿil; الحياة: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); الدنيا: a naʿt (adjective); زينتها: conjoined to الحياة.
﴿فتعالين أمتعكن وأسرحكن سراحا جميلا﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), because it comes as a clause of request; تعالين: an imperative verb, indeclinable on the sukūn, the nūn being the fāʿil; أمتعكن: an imperfect verb, jussive because it is the response to the request; أسرحكن: conjoined to أمتعكن; سراحًا: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); جميلا: an adjective.

muyesser-irab:29-29.t: ﴿وإن كنتن تردن الله ورسوله والدار الآخرة فإن الله أعد للمحسنات منكن أجرا عظيما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; إن: conditional; كنتن: a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters) in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ being its noun and the nūn the sign of the feminine plural; the clause ﴿تردن﴾ is the khabar (predicate) of kāna, the nūn being the fāʿil (agent) of تردن, and the word of majesty (Allah) is mafʿūl bihi (direct object); رسوله: conjoined to the word of majesty; الدار: also conjoined to the word of majesty; الآخرة: a naʿt (adjective); the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); إنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty being its noun; the clause ﴿أعد للمحسنات﴾ is the khabar of إنّ; منكن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from المحسنات; أجرًا: mafʿūl bihi; عظيمًا: an adjective.

muyesser-irab:30-30.t:
﴿يا نساء النبي من يأت منكن بفاحشة مبينة يضاعف لها العذاب ضعفين﴾: يا: a vocative particle; نساء: the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) because it is annexed; النبي: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); مَن: a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); يأتِ: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; منكن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of يأتِ; بفاحشة: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يأتِ; مبينة: a naʿt (adjective); يضاعف: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive, the sign of its jussive being the sukūn; لَها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يضاعف; العذاب: the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) of يضاعف; ضعفين: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative with the yāʾ because it is a dual.
﴿وكان ذلك على الله يسيرا﴾: the wāw is circumstantial or resumptive; كان: a defective past verb (kāna and its sisters); ذلك: its noun; على الله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to يسيرًا; يسيرًا: the khabar (predicate) of كان; the clause is in the position of accusative as a ḥāl, or resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:31-31.t:
﴿ومن يقنت منكن لله ورسوله وتعمل صالحا نؤتها أجرها مرتين﴾: the wāw is a conjunction, and ﴿من يقنت﴾ is conjoined to ﴿من يأتِ﴾; مَن: a jussive conditional noun in the position of nominative as mubtadaʾ (subject); يقنت: the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), jussive (majzūm), the sign of its jussive being the sukūn; منكن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of يقنت; لله: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يقنت﴾; رسوله: conjoined to the word of majesty (Allah); تعمل: conjoined to ﴿يقنت﴾; صالحا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of ﴿تعمل﴾, or standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar (verbal noun), i.e. "he did a righteous deed" (عمل عملًا صالحًا) [Translator's note: the source's paraphrase uses the masculine past عمل; تعمل عملًا صالحًا would match the verse]. نؤتها: the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), an imperfect verb, jussive by the dropping of the weak letter, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "we", and ﴿ها﴾ is the first mafʿūl bihi; أجرها: the second mafʿūl bihi of ﴿نؤتها﴾; مرتين: standing in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, because it is the number of the maṣdar.
﴿وأعتدنا لها رزقا كريما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; أعتدنا: a past verb and its fāʿil; لها: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to أعتدنا; رزقًا: mafʿūl bihi; كريما: an adjective; the clause ﴿أعتدنا لها﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿نؤتها﴾.

muyesser-irab:32-32.t:
﴿يا نساء النبي لستن كأحد من النساء إن اتقيتن﴾: يا: a vocative particle; نساء: the one addressed (munādā), accusative (manṣūb) because it is annexed; النبي: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); لستن: a defective (nāqiṣ) verb, the tāʾ being the noun of ليس and the nūn the sign of the feminine plural; كأحد: the kāf is a noun meaning "like" (مثل), indeclinable (mabnī) on the fatḥa, in the position of accusative as the khabar (predicate) of ليس, and ﴿أحد﴾ is muḍāf ilayhi; من النساء: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted adjective of ﴿أحد﴾; إن: conditional; اتقيتن: a past verb in the position of jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the tāʾ being the fāʿil (agent) and the nūn the sign of the feminine plural; the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ) is either omitted, indicated by what precedes it, i.e. "if you fear Allah, then you are not like anyone" (إن اتقيتن الله فلستن كأحد), or the apodosis is His words ﴿فلا تخضعن بالقول﴾.
﴿فلا تخضعن بالقول﴾: a resumption, with the apodosis omitted as stated above; or the fāʾ links the apodosis, and the clause ﴿لا تخضعن﴾ is in the position of jussive as the apodosis; بالقول: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to تخضعن; the clause ﴿فلا تخضعن﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿فيطمع الذي في قلبه مرض﴾: فيطمع: ﴿الفاء﴾ is for causation (sababiyya), and ﴿يطمع﴾ is an imperfect verb, accusative by a concealed أن after the fāʾ of causation; the interpreted maṣdar is conjoined to a maṣdar extracted from the preceding speech, i.e. "let there be no softness, and (so no) desire" (لا يكن خضوع فطمع). الذي: the fāʿil of يطمع; في قلبه: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted fronted khabar; مرض: a postponed mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause ﴿في قلبه مرض﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of الذي, with no grammatical position.
﴿وقلن قولا معروفا﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; قلن: an imperative verb, the nūn being the fāʿil; قولا: mafʿūl bihi (direct object), or mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), accusative with the fatḥa. معروفا: an adjective; the clause ﴿قلن قولا معروفا﴾ is conjoined to the clause ﴿لا تخضعن﴾.

muyesser-irab:33-33.t:
﴿وقرن في بيوتكن ولا تبرجن تبرج الجاهلية الأولى﴾: conjoined to the clause ﴿لا تخضعن﴾; قرن: an imperative verb, the nūn being the fāʿil (agent); في بيوتكن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿قرن﴾; لا: prohibitive; تبرجن: an imperfect verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the sukūn because it is attached to the nūn of the feminine plural, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; تبرج: mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object); الجاهلية: muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); الأولى: a naʿt (adjective) of الجاهلية.
﴿وأقمن الصلاة وآتين الزكاة وأطعن الله ورسوله﴾: also conjoined; أقمن: a verb and its fāʿil; الصلاة: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); آتين: a verb and its fāʿil; الزكاة: the object of ﴿آتين﴾; أطعن: a verb and its fāʿil; the word of majesty (Allah) is the object of أطعن; رسوله: conjoined to the word of majesty.
﴿إنما يريد الله ليذهب عنكم الرجس أهل البيت ويطهركم تطهيرا﴾: إنما: the restraining (kāffa) and restrained (makfūfa) particle; يريد: an imperfect verb; الله: fāʿil; ﴿ليذهب﴾: the lām is causal (lām al-taʿlīl), and يذهب is an imperfect verb, accusative (manṣūb) by a concealed أن after the lām, its fāʿil latent (mustatir), implied as "he"; the concealed ﴿أن﴾ with the imperfect verb after it forms an interpreted maṣdar, genitive (majrūr) by the causal lām, and the lām with what it governs is attached to ﴿يريد﴾; the object of يريد is omitted, the implied form being: "Allah only wills His commanding and forbidding you, in order to remove impurity from you" (إنما يريد الله أمركم ونهيكم ليذهب عنكم الرجس), or "He only wills of you what He wills, in order to remove impurity from you" (إنما يريد منكم ما يريد ليذهب عنكم الرجس), or the like. Or the lām in ﴿ليذهب﴾ is ṣila (i.e. redundant), and يذهب is an imperfect verb, accusative by an implied maṣdariyya أن after the lām, and the interpreted maṣdar from ﴿أن يذهب﴾ is the object of يريد, the implied form being: "Allah wills the removal of impurity from you" (يريد الله إذهاب الرجس عنكم). عنكم: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يذهب﴾; الرجس: mafʿūl bihi; أهلَ: the one addressed (munādā), accusative because it is annexed, the vocative particle being omitted; or ﴿أهل﴾ is accusative by specification (ikhtiṣāṣ) for praise, i.e. "I specify the people of the House" (أخص أهل البيت). البيت: muḍāf ilayhi; يطهركم: conjoined to ﴿يُذهِب﴾; تطهيرًا: mafʿūl muṭlaq; the clause ﴿إنما يريد ...﴾ gives the reason for all that preceded.

muyesser-irab:34-34.t:
﴿واذكرن ما يتلى في بيوتكن من آيات الله والحكمة﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; اذكرن: an imperative verb, the nūn of the feminine plural being the fāʿil (agent); ما: mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿يُتلى﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position. يتلى: an imperfect verb built for that whose agent is not named (passive), its nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent) latent (mustatir), referring to ﴿ما﴾; في بيوتكن: a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتلى﴾; من آيات الله: a preposition, its genitive noun and a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct), the preposition and its genitive noun being attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the relative noun ﴿ما﴾ or from the nāʾib fāʿil of يُتلى; الحكمة: conjoined to ﴿آيات الله﴾.
﴿إن الله كان لطيفا خبيرا﴾: إنّ: an abrogating particle (inna and its sisters), the word of majesty (Allah) being its noun; كان: a defective (nāqiṣ) verb, the noun of كان being latent, referring to Allah; لطيفًا: the first khabar (predicate) of كان; خبيرًا: the second khabar of كان; the clause ﴿كان لطيفا خبيرا﴾ is the khabar of إنّ.
